harness.all_can_red: ---- found %(count)d gates, all of them can go red ✓
harness.configurable_ok: ✓ all five names renamed, %(ok)d/%(total)d green; under default names [%(red)s] all red ⇒ nothing hard-coded
harness.empty_red_list: ✗ red list is empty — zero-value guard: without it this section proves nothing
harness.heading: Gate selftest (discovery roster):

harness.no_probes: ✗ zero-language probe list is empty — zero-value guard

harness.plugins_heading: ── Pluggable plugins and named selftests (roster derived from registry) ──
